title: Acceleration of Protein Degradation by 20S Proteasome-Binding Peptides Generated by In Vitro Artificial Evolution.
authors: Zhu, Yunhao; Shigeyoshi, Kaishin; Hayakawa, Yumiko; Fujiwara, Sae; Kishida, Masamichi; Ohki, Hitoshi; Horibe, Tomohisa; Shionyu, Masafumi; Mizukami, Tamio; Hasegawa, Makoto
one_liner_zh: 该文通过体外人工进化筛选20S蛋白酶体结合肽，结合对接模拟揭示其开启α环门控促进无序蛋白α-synuclein降解的机制，虽聚焦无序蛋白底物与互作机制，但方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟仅作辅助，故评6分。
abstract: Although the 20S core particle (CP) of the proteasome is an important component of the 26S holoenzyme, the stand-alone 20S CP acts directly on intrinsically disordered and oxidized/damaged proteins to degrade them in a ubiquitin-independent manner. It has been postulated that some structural features of substrate proteins are recognized by the 20S CP to promote substrate uptake, but the mechanism of substrate recognition has not been fully elucidated. In this study, we screened peptides that bind to the 20S CP from a random eight-residue pool of amino acid sequences using complementary DNA display an in vitro molecular evolution technique. The identified 20S CP-binding amino acid sequence was chemically synthesized and its effects on the 20S CP were investigated. The 20S CP-binding peptide stimulated the proteolytic activity of the inactive form of 20S CP. The peptide bound directly to one of the alpha-subunits, opening a gate for substrate entry on the alpha-ring. Furthermore, the attachment of this peptide sequence to alpha-synuclein enhanced its degradation by the 20S CP in vitro. In addition to these results, docking simulations indicated that this peptide binds to the top surface of the alpha-ring. These peptides could function as a key to control the opening of the alpha-ring gate.
abstract_zh: 尽管蛋白酶体的20S核心颗粒（CP）是26S全酶的重要组成部分，但独立的20S CP直接作用于 intrinsically disordered（内在无序）和氧化/损伤蛋白，以不依赖泛素的方式将其降解。已有假设认为，底物蛋白的某些结构特征被20S CP识别以促进底物摄取，但底物识别的机制尚未完全阐明。在本研究中，我们利用互补DNA展示（一种体外分子进化技术）从随机八残基氨基酸序列库中筛选出与20S CP结合的肽段。将鉴定出的20S CP结合氨基酸序列进行化学合成，并研究其对20S CP的影响。该20S CP结合肽刺激了非活性形式20S CP的蛋白水解活性。该肽直接结合于一个α亚基，在α环上打开底物进入的门控。此外，将此肽序列附着于α-突触核蛋白上，增强了其在体外被20S CP降解的能力。除这些结果外，对接模拟表明该肽结合于α环的顶面。这些肽可能作为控制α环门控开启的关键因子。
